Sanitized_Summary: Standing governance instruction treated as authority to dispatch new work while execution window was occupied.
Status synthesis used only one of two supplied workstream handbacks and required a reread.
Coordination reply mixed immediate and dependency-gated actions without clearly separating sequence.
Open-ended vendor-question request expanded into a large diligence pack when a short urgent screen was wanted.
External brief reused stale project scope instead of revalidating against the new audience and context.
Source-declared database columns were treated as proven live schema and forced a specification rewrite.
Contradictory rules were allowed to coexist in a specification rather than being reconciled.
Invalid SQL uniqueness syntax was treated as valid until corrected.
Inline transport was assumed byte-preserving and the received artifact failed fingerprint checks.
A byte-line discrepancy was attributed to blank-line loss without sufficient evidence and later withdrawn.
Observation from one execution context was generalized to a different production service context.
A blocking-lock mechanism was described as compatible with a non-blocking concurrency claim.
A data structure recording alert intent was treated as if it proved the full operational alert capability.
The term additive was interpreted as net-new capability despite revocations backfills and destructive changes.
A design problem was reduced to a false binary choice despite a wider intended solution space.
Byte-identical was interpreted as preservation of prior values even though new populated fields changed the row.
A fingerprinted artifact was treated as unavailable because the delivered attachment was not recognized at that moment.
Search-command context lines were counted as mutation sites creating a false inventory discrepancy.
A pinned review revision was assumed current without a final currency check causing review of the wrong revision.
A strict approval-threshold interpretation produced no observable user mismatch and is retained as comparison.
A later attached artifact was again treated as missing because its identity could not be matched to a delivered file.
Two plausible diff-count interpretations were explicitly disclosed rather than silently resolved.
Extraction instruction was interpreted to include a raw transcript recovered from disk rather than only retained chat context.
A persistent role-header convention was retained while executing a neutral-extractor instruction.
Permission for a read-only probe was interpreted narrowly so existing surfaces were searched without constructing a new request path.
Platform helper functions were treated as outside a pre-inspection prohibition then called before definition inspection and later disclosed.
Multiple ambiguities were surfaced explicitly before commitment and produced no rework.
Branch instruction was interpreted as permitting a fresh clone because the expected repository was not at the working path.
A proof requirement was interpreted as satisfiable with focused pure checks and source assertions.
Deterministic action-ID requirement was interpreted as needing handling changes but no separate generation change.
Not merged was interpreted as still permitting a push of the unmerged handoff branch.
Extraction-protocol attachment was interpreted as applying to the current thread and authorizing creation of an extraction file.
Strict rebase-before-push rule was not followed as the base advanced creating deletion risk.
Intentionally failing proof suite was interpreted as something that should remain outside default CI discovery.
Passing one ordinary reproduction shape was treated as disproving a broader failure class requiring multiple shapes.
Seven-case proof order was interpreted as permitting a new dedicated proof file even though no filename was specified.
Mirror the real configuration exactly was interpreted as exact values without timestamp-hash provenance.
Requirement that defect assertions be marked was interpreted as satisfied by names-footer rather than adjacent labels.
A timestamp proxy was disclosed before use and no later mismatch occurred.
Type-checking and building were run concurrently causing transient generated-file errors fixed by sequential rerun.
A branch became stale despite a rebase-before-push rule again creating deletion risk.
Local configuration approximations were used as stand-in for production values before a frozen fixture existed.
Correct-only-six-call-sites instruction was treated as excluding other mismatches despite a parallel verify-every-argument instruction.
Deliver-the-complete-file instruction was interpreted as satisfied by a local path-link rather than a transferable artifact.
Bare attachment-request label was interpreted conservatively as permission to inspect and compare but not edit or execute.
Send-only-three-things instruction was interpreted as restricting final handback but not execution-time commentary.
SQL content supplied without explicit imperative was treated as authorization to execute read-only production queries.
Installation authorization was assumed to cover all filesystem paths the package manager needed but a required path was not writable.
Browser-auth flow relied on terminal-tool output to expose a one-time code the user could not actually see.
Authorization for a child configuration path was assumed sufficient although its parent directory could not be created.
Requested outcome of one commit and one draft PR was treated as requiring a particular local CLI auth method and stalled for several exchanges.
Strict rebase-no-deletion rule was not kept current as the base advanced creating stale-base deletion risk.
